_comment: Q4 2026 draft assortment. Costs are ESTIMATES from research/squishy-store/03 and 04 until supplier quotes arrive; set quote_status to 'quoted' and replace unit_cost when real. All Phase 1 SKUs must be authorised US wholesale stock that already carries a Children's Product Certificate (CPC).

skus.name: Capybara Taba Squishy (medium)
skus.notes: Hero SKU. Capybara still rising per Toy Fair 2026.
skus.copy: A slow-rebound silicone capybara with the sticky, satisfying taba squish. Sits on a desk, survives a bag, and comes back to shape every time.

skus.name: Steamed Bun Taba Squishy
skus.copy: A steamed bun that squishes like dough and slowly puffs back. Silicone, not foam, so it stays soft for months.

skus.name: Pudding Taba Squishy (small)
skus.copy: A pocket-sized pudding with a wobble. Small enough for a coat pocket, satisfying enough for a meeting.

skus.name: Mystery Dumpling Squishy (blind bag)
skus.notes: Peak-trend item; confirm no water-bead filler (2026 recalls).
skus.copy: One mystery dumpling from the current series, sealed in its blind bag. Foam, no liquid fill.

skus.name: Jumbo Croissant Slow-Rise (25 cm)
skus.notes: Content hero for ASMR/unboxing. Bulky: check parcel stays <1 lb in bundles.
skus.copy: A 25 cm slow-rising croissant. Press it flat, watch it rise back over ten seconds. The one everyone reaches for first.

skus.name: Jumbo Cheese Wedge Slow-Rise
skus.copy: A jumbo slow-rising cheese wedge with a soft skin and a very slow rise.

skus.name: NeeDoh Classic Ball
skus.notes: Only if allocation obtained. Branded, tested; never substitute an unbranded gel dupe.
skus.copy: The genuine Schylling NeeDoh classic ball, the toy that started the 2026 squish craze.

skus.name: Capybara Squishy Bag Charm
skus.copy: A mini capybara squishy on a clip, for bags, keys or a desk lamp.

skus.name: Magnetic Fidget Slug
skus.notes: Desk-calm bundle component; contains magnets, check ASTM F963 magnet clause on CPC.
skus.copy: An articulated magnetic slug that clicks, curls and stacks. The fidget for grown-up desks.

skus.name: Kawaii Food Sticker Sheet
skus.notes: Free insert in every order; boosts unboxing content.
skus.copy: A sheet of kawaii food stickers, free in every order.

bundles.name: Desk Calm Trio
bundles.positioning: For grown-ups: two taba squishies and a magnetic slug for the desk.

bundles.name: Snack Shelf Set
bundles.positioning: Jumbo croissant, a mystery dumpling and a pudding: the food-squishy starter set.

bundles.name: Gift Under $30
bundles.positioning: Capybara squishy plus matching bag charm, gift-wrapped.

bundles.name: Mystery Squish Bag
bundles.positioning: Two small tabas and a capybara bag charm; exact designs vary and duplicates are avoided within a bag.
bundles.notes: Blind-bag format only clears $10 CM on wholesale stock at $29.99; it becomes the hero format with own-brand costs in Phase 3.
